description: This PHP class file defines the OAuth2Clients class, which extends the SugarBean class, for managing OAuth2 client credentials within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes properties for client secret, redirect URI, allowed grant types, and methods for saving client data and setting duration values based on request parameters.

classes.name: OAuth2Clients
classes.description: A class representing OAuth2 client information in SuiteCRM, including properties for client credentials and methods for managing OAuth2 client records.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the name of the OAuth2 client as a summary string.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overridden save method that hashes a new secret if provided and sets duration values before calling parent save.

methods.name: setDurationValue
methods.description: Sets the duration_value property based on request parameters for duration amount and unit, with default to 1 minute.
